comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus install a portable grounding set in the mandated ground-first order.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use controlled clockwise tightening and stabilization; candidate adjusts and locks a collar with a hex key, while record hangs two heavy clamps on specified bars and turns their eye-screw sticks to develop clamping force.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two qualified stops and a drift-resistant setting; record requires the ground clamp tight before any phase-bar contact, the line clamp tight on tagged bar B, hands released, and a successful tug check without touching bars A or C.
comparison.reason: Ordered safety-critical clamp placement and verified electrical grounding geometry are materially different from dynamic damper tuning. Candidate rebound, overload, and collar-drift thresholds remain undeclared.
